name: Hundred-Call Breath (Bách Minh Tức)
concept: A bird catcher's breathing, done in the canopy at dawn and dusk when the birds call. The disciple learns one call per layer and breathes with it: Wood qi drawn in as the forest breathes, a little Fire let out on the call. A catcher at the sixth layer can bring a wild bird to the hand without a net. It is a quiet method and makes quiet people.
lore: Tuyên Bách Minh's calls, written down by Tạ Thanh Thước in 1112 so that the catchers' children would not have to learn them only by ear.

name: Roosting Branch Canon (Thê Chi Kinh)
concept: The pavilion's method: the cultivator makes herself a tree that spirit birds will roost in. Each layer grows one more branch of the meridians that a bonded bird can perch on, and a cultivator at the ninth layer carries three birds whose qi flows into hers and hers into theirs. In a fight the birds strike, scout and shield; when a bird is hurt, the holder feels it, and when the holder heals, so do they.
lore: Made by Tạ Thanh Loan and her sister between 1110 and 1140 from the palace's bird-keeping notes, which Vu Ngô Đồng lent them, and from what they knew of birds. It is the newest main method of any of the palace's vassals.

name: Moulted Feather Fan (Thoái Vũ Phiến Quyết)

effects.name: Hundred-Feather Fan
effects.rule: For each different feather kind in the holder's fan (approximated by +2 % Fire debuff duration per layer of Moulted Feather Fan), her Fire stacks last a little longer.

concept: A fan art made with feathers gathered only from moults. The fan's feathers keep the qi of the birds that shed them; a stroke throws them burning, and each kind of feather does a different small thing. A keeper's fan shows how many kinds she has gathered, and the art grows stronger with every new kind added.
lore: The pavilion makes the inner gate's practice fans for Phượng Minh, and this is the fan art the palace does not teach: the palace's Morning Sun Feather Fan burns feathers it is given, and this one keeps the birds' own qi.

name: Woven Cage Breath (Biên Lung Tức)
concept: The pavilion's servant craft method for the one cage-maker Bách Vũ Các permits. Metal and Earth qi are drawn steadily through the hands to temper split bamboo and wire; it opens no gate and teaches no bird calls.
lore: Passed to Hoàn Trúc Lung when he came up from the raft villages to weave training cages and travelling baskets for the lofts.
